The '''1931–32 [[Super League Greece|Panhellenic Championship]]''' was the fourth season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. [[Aris Thessaloniki F.C.|Aris]] won their 2nd championship. [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]], [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] and [[PAOK FC|PAOK]] qualified for the relegation play-offs for the Athenian, Piraeus' and Macedonian Association, respectively.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oiassoitouareos.gr/thriamvos-toy-makedonikoy-podosfai/|title=? ΘΡΙΑΜΒΟΣ ΤΟΥ ΜΑΚΕΔΟΝΙΚΟΥ ΠΟΔΟΣΦΑΙΡΟΥ|website=Οι Άσσοι του Άρεως|accessdate=7 May 2023}}</ref> AEK and Olympiacos prevailed in the play-off matches and remained in the national division. PAOK did not take part in the play-off matches against [[Megas Alexandros Thessaloniki|Megas Alexandros]], which were scheduled for 18 and 22 September 1932,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://srv-web1.parliament.gr/display_doc.asp?item=43504|title=Αθλητικά Χρονικά, 19 και 23 September 1932|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210428170249/https://srv-web1.parliament.gr/display_doc.asp?item=43504|archive-date=28 April 2021}} (dp. 491, 501)</ref> protesting against the decision of the HFF,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://efimeris.nlg.gr/ns/pdfwin_ftr.asp?c=124&pageid=-1&id=52517&s=0&STEMTYPE=0&STEM_WORD_PHONETIC_IDS=&CropPDF=0|title=Εφημερίδα «Μακεδονία», paper 23 July 1932|website=efimeris.nlg.gr|access-date=11 April 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://srv-web1.parliament.gr/display_doc.asp?item=43504|title=Αθλητικά Χρονικά, 23 July 1932}} (dp. 345)</ref> which was issued on July 22, 1932, while PAOK had ended his league games, canceling his 3–2 win over [[Iraklis F.C. (Thessaloniki)|Iraklis]] on 5 June 1932,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://efimeris.nlg.gr/ns/pdfwin_ftr.asp?c=124&pageid=-1&id=56340&s=0&STEMTYPE=0&STEM_WORD_PHONETIC_IDS=&CropPDF=0|title= εφημεριδα ΜΑΚΕΔΟΝΙΑ 6/6/1932|website=efimeris.nlg.gr|access-date=2020-01-29}}</ref> following the objection of Iraklis against the referee that kept only 1 minute of stoppage time for to the club's supporters storming the pitch and the police intervention<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://efimeris.nlg.gr/ns/pdfwin_ftr.asp?c=124&pageid=-1&id=52644&s=0&STEMTYPE=0&STEM_WORD_PHONETIC_IDS=&CropPDF=0|title=Εφ. Μακεδονία, paper 26 July 1932, p.3|website=efimeris.nlg.gr|access-date=2 October 2019}}</ref> to restore order. The match was scheduled to be repeated at the neutral [[Nikos Goumas Stadium|AEK Stadium]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://efimeris.nlg.gr/ns/pdfwin_ftr.asp?c=124&pageid=-1&id=53797&s=0&STEMTYPE=0&STEM_WORD_PHONETIC_IDS=&CropPDF=0|title=Εφ. Μακεδονία, paper 10 September 1932, p.3 |website=efimeris.nlg.gr|publisher=ΕΦΗΜΕΡΙΔΑ ΜΑΚΕΔΟΝΙΑ|access-date=26 June 2019}}</ref> in Athens on September 11.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://srv-web1.parliament.gr/display_doc.asp?item=43504|title=Αθλητικά Χρονικά, 8 September 1932}} (dp. 467)</ref> PAOK did not appear in the match and Iraklis was declared the winner without a match by the decision of the HFF,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://srv-web1.parliament.gr/display_doc.asp?item=43504|title=Αθλητικά Χρονικά, 14 και 15 September 1932}} (dp. 479,485)</ref> overtaking PAOK in the standings. PAOK was then appointed by the HFF to give double qualifying matches with the then champion of Macedonia Megas Alexandros, however it did not show up again in either of the two matches, as a result of which it lost both games without a match. Thus, [[PAOK FC|PAOK]] were relegated to the regional championship of Macedonia for the first time in its history. 

It was held as a national division, in which 8 teams from the 3 founding Associations of the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]], participated and resulted as follows:
*'''[[Athens Football Clubs Association|Athenian]] Championship''': The first 3 teams of the [[1930–31 Panhellenic Championship#League Table|1930–31]] ranking.
*'''[[Piraeus Football Clubs Association|Piraeus']] Championship''': The first 2 teams of the [[1930–31 Panhellenic Championship#League Table|1930–31]] ranking.
*'''[[Macedonia Football Clubs Association|Macedonian]] Championship''': The first 3 teams of the [[1930–31 Panhellenic Championship#League Table|1930–31]] ranking.
These teams did not participate in the regional championships and their stay in the national division was judged by a play-off round. According to the regulations of the time, whoever finished in a lower position than the other teams of the same Association had to play a two-legged round against the winner of the corresponding regional championship to decide who will qualify for the [[1932–33 Panhellenic Championship]].
 
The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point'' - ''Loss: 0 points''.

: a. {{Note label|A|a|none}} PAOK refused to participate to the relegation play-offs as a protest to the decision of [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]] to cancel the 3–2 win over Iraklis that would have PAOK qualified directly to the next season's championship. As a result, PAOK did not show up for any of the matches and both were awarded 2–0 to Megas Alexandros.
{{refend}}
